assumptions: Fantrax Min/Max verifies period 2, 2026-10-26–2026-11-01: minimum 35 and maximum 55. Calendar-day prorating is not assumed.
Flex slots accept all observed basketball positions. Individual eligibility comes from the league roster view.
No IR/minors activations or acquisitions are assumed. Expected return dates are conditional, not medical clearance.
Schedule includes all visible games for the captured roster; other NBA teams are not a complete free-agent schedule.
Historical FP/G uses three prior seasons with available evidence; older rounded/partial snapshots retain that limitation.

claims.basis: Allowance for the selected planning week only; Monday resets are separate from matchup boundaries. Recheck successful and pending claims before acting

waivers.reason: Free-agent eligibility, waiver clearance, bid/claim timing and center-limit counting need verified candidate data.

comparisons.reason: Daily historical rosters and credited GP are not captured; Fantrax optimal cap behavior is unverified.
